title: Mersenne Representation, the Conolly Sequence, and Soliton Profiles over Finite Fields
summary: We study the Mersenne representation of nonnegative integers and its decomposition into the binary and nonbinary sides. The nonbinary values form A055938, and their successor structure gives a direct proof of the relation between A055938 and A080578 that is recorded as conjectural in the OEIS entry for A080578. The binary-side counting function is identified with a shifted Conolly sequence. We then develop the parent map, truncation blocks, truncation remainders, and the Mersenne tau function associated with this representation. The parent map is conjugate to deletion of the lowest digit.…
